preregistered_outcomes.A2_collapse_at_r_le_10: If the A2 self-consistency attacker (no PAD model of any kind) drives session caught-rate below the genuine session false-alarm rate at r <= 10, the session-level defence is defeated by a free, knowledge-free attacker. THAT is the finding.
preregistered_outcomes.only_A3_collapses: If only the A3 oracle collapses it, the defence holds against realistic attackers and the oracle result is a curiosity.
preregistered_outcomes.A1_but_not_A2: If A1 (surrogate-filtered) collapses it but A2 does not, the finding is that the defence costs the attacker one surrogate model, and the price of that model is the real security margin.
preregistered_outcomes.otherwise: Anything else is inconclusive and will be reported as inconclusive.

collapse_definition: caught-rate at the calibrated operating point <= the genuine session false-alarm rate measured at that same operating point on the held-out users (i.e. the detector is at or below chance).
primary_session_statistic: sum over scored events of a per-action 41-quantile score log-likelihood-ratio (LLR). Mean-LLR reported as a declared secondary variant.
calibration: user-disjoint 2-fold split of the 20 test users (fixed by sorted user id, even/odd index); LLR bins and the session threshold are fitted on the calibration half and evaluated on the held-out half; folds swapped and pooled. Oracle (all-20) variant reported alongside with the gap.
duration_llr_fit_split: development users only (10 users, user-disjoint from test), for B2 and all of Part B.
uncertainty: user-clustered bootstrap over the 20 test users, 2000 replicates, F9.
denominator: SESSION. Every false-alarm rate reported in Parts A and C is per genuine session unless explicitly labelled per-event.
part_B_acceptance_test: After quantile-mapping fake durations onto the per-action genuine duration distribution, the duration-only session LLR must be at chance (caught within the bootstrap CI of the session false-alarm rate). If it is not, the mapping failed and that is reported as a failure.
